mechanism.name: Michael：作者代码纵向MSMM机制

sampling.unit: 独立受试者的完整T步轨迹，宽表一行一个人
sampling.dependence: iid subjects, each with a full T=3 trajectory. A_(t-1) feeds into L_t; U_t is shared between L and treatment/outcome. Source implementation makes U_t recoverable from observed history; no irreducible hidden-confounding claim.

assumptions: 一致性、序贯IV相关/排除/给定历史的独立及正性；正确MSMM；保留作者代码的共享U结构，不能宣称不可恢复的未测混杂

properties.notes: Baseline L1 is observed before A1; L2 and L3 are time-varying covariates, not extra baseline dimensions. One row retains the full T=3 trajectory. Delta(L)*Z in treatment probability; normal-CDF and logistic links. Author code has U_t=L_t-Lmean_t, recoverable from observed history; no irreducible hidden-confounding label. Baseline-dimension convention: p=1, effective_p=1, baseline_columns=['L1']; instruments, posttreatment variables, time points and network nodes are excluded. Reference sample size n_ref=128 independent subjects (the CPU interface-check setting), p/n_ref=0.00781250; high_dimensional=false refers to baseline p in this stated setting, not the full observed-column count. n remains a runtime argument; reassess the dimension/sample-size regime if n or p changes rather than treating this tag as a guarantee for arbitrary scaling.

estimand.name: beta_T
estimand.definition: beta_T：最后一次处理增加1的MSMM均值效应，1。

truth.expression: beta_T：最后一次处理增加1的MSMM均值效应，1。
truth.derivation: Analytic final-time unit intervention beta_T=1; treatment feedback cancels in centered L increments. Actual-source probability thresholds and nonzero-U trajectories supplement zero-path checks.

adaptations: Use complete pinned-author DGP; do not combine beta=1 with older preprint Eq41 coefficients.
Wide table retains full longitudinal history; report final-time causal coefficient. New local RNG; no R estimator/bootstrap code executed.
warnings: No explicit latent-variable metadata or reliably identifiable latent declarations; absence from this list does not prove that no latent variables exist.
